mapper.select: select count(*) from cart where goods_num = #{goods_num} and member_id = #{member_id}
mapper.insert: insert into cart(goods_num, member_id, cart_goods_qty) values(#{goods_num}, #{member_id}, #{cart_goods_qty})
mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_id, c.goods_num, c.member_id, c.cart_goods_qty, g.goods_name, g.goods_sales_price, g.goods_point, i.fileName FROM cart c JOIN goods g ON c.goods_num = g.goods_num LEFT JOIN goods_image i ON g.goods_num = i.goods_num WHERE c.member_id = #{member_id} AND (i.fileType = 'main' OR i.fileType IS NULL)
